program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. You receive no reference label or optimization feedback. Return status, evidence, reported confidence (0..1 or null), and used_dependency_ids naming every supplied context check_id exactly once in saved order.
Supports receive source and edited images. Answer only the saved proposition using its binding and criteria. Use pass/fail/unknown. Context is advisory unless listed in required_dependencies. A negative context observation is usable evidence. Unknown, skipped, or invalid context is not a failure and must not stop an independent image inspection. Inspect the images yourself; do not repeat a parent's answer. Return unknown when the relevant fact cannot be established. Confidence reports confidence in this answer, not calibrated correctness.
Fulfillment receives NO images. Use only saved support evidence, original instruction/rubric and frozen composition criteria. Return complete/partial/absent/unknown. Supporting passes answer specific propositions, not a count of completed edits. Their polarity can differ. Apply saved alternatives: optional uncertainty need not prevent a known outcome, but a required unresolved fact makes that outcome unresolved. Never invent a visual fact or convert missing evidence into failure. A conditional skip is not non-applicability. All applicable requested outcomes complete gives yes; no requested progress gives no; known progress short of completion gives partial. Unrelated changes are not progress.

Ensure the node applies the stated evidence conditions consistently. Do not force “no” from the reference label; it constrains the aggregate but does not establish atomic evidence.

Strengthen the node’s source-to-edit identity test: require reliable visual or contextual correspondence for both objects before judging progress, and do not treat color, proximity, or a hand-held item near a round shape as sufficient evidence. If either match or placement is not assessable, return unknown rather than pass or fail. Keep the progress criterion distinct from completion: only count observable movement of the matched paper toward or into the matched cup. Also verify routing and dependency semantics: this support check is parented to s1, yet the trace has no dependencies and appears to determine partial on its own while s1 is unknown. Ensure the node is queried and interpreted consistently with its parent and the aggregate’s evidence requirements. Treat the reference label as an aggregate constraint, not proof that this individual check must be no; separate any execution or routing issue from the visual evidence.

Keep unknown when identity or placement cannot be assessed, and do not infer progress from proximity or a hand-held item alone. However, do not tighten binding to require exact appearance: the existing source-role/context matching explicitly allows appearance changes, and the edit may depict a transformed paper. Preserve that allowance while requiring affirmative contextual evidence that both edited objects correspond to the source objects. The reference “no” constrains the aggregate, not this atomic check, so do not force a fail from it. Separately inspect routing and aggregation: this node has no dependencies or parent in the supplied node data, despite downstream notes alleging inconsistent parent/dependency behavior.
